name: comprehensive-rust
description_en: This is the Rust course used by the Android team at Google. It provides you the material to quickly teach Rust.
readme_excerpt: Comprehensive Rust 🦀 This repository has the source code for Comprehensive Rust 🦀, a multi-day Rust course developed by the Android team. The course covers all aspects of Rust, from basic syntax to generics and error handling. It also includes deep dives on [Android], [Chromium], [bare-metal], and [concurrency].
